rationale: V3 six-slot 30pct sizing losses despite positive unclustered trade PF; test breadth-style basket rather than cherry-pick winners

robustness.report: 95% CI of event equal-weight average net trade PnL and event-level PF where meaningful; do not treat per-symbol trades as independent

limitations: liquidity and slippage not modeled by static 40bp
decision: require 2022-23, 2024, 2025-26 positive account simulations with stable priority; and event bootstrap lower confidence bound >0, else reject as reliable practical edge
